title: AiMotionRequest
description: AI-facing request schema for deterministic image motion compilation. The upstream AI should analyze the image first, then provide structure, regions, reading order, and motion intent here.

version.description: Schema version for the AI motion request. Must be exactly '1.0'.

goal.description: High-level animation goal chosen by the upstream AI.

platform.description: Optional target platform hint for future policy and pacing choices.

durationSeconds.description: Total requested output duration in seconds.

style.description: Optional motion style hint. This affects recipe tuning but not recipe selection precedence.

preferredRecipe.description: Optional explicit recipe override. Provide this only when the upstream AI is confident which recipe should be used.

id.description: Stable asset identifier supplied by the upstream AI or orchestration layer.

path.description: Path to the source image. This can be an absolute filesystem path or a project-relative path. The compiler does not inspect the image contents.

kind.description: Image category determined by the upstream AI.

description.description: Optional plain-language description from the upstream AI. This field is informational and should not drive core camera routing.

layout.description: Global layout classification inferred by the upstream AI.

regions.description: Visual regions of interest. All region coordinates must use source-image pixel coordinates, not normalized coordinates.

id.description: Stable region identifier used by readingOrder, primaryRegionId, overlays, and captions.

role.description: Semantic role assigned by the upstream AI.

label.description: Human-readable label used only for debugging or label overlays.

importance.description: Optional numeric importance score. Higher values suggest stronger emphasis.

order.description: Optional explicit ordering index when the upstream AI has strong ordering confidence.

motionHint.description: Optional local motion hint provided by the upstream AI.

readingOrder.description: Ordered region ids representing how the upstream AI believes the image should be viewed.

primaryRegionId.description: Optional main region id for the final hold or primary emphasis.

script.description: Optional already-authored text payload. Captions may be attached to regions, but script text must not decide the core motion route.

title.description: Optional display title if the upstream AI already has one.

text.description: Caption text to render exactly as provided.

start.description: Optional caption start time in seconds.

end.description: Optional caption end time in seconds.

attachToRegionId.description: Optional region id the caption belongs to.

constraints.description: Optional safety and motion constraints supplied by the upstream AI.

avoidCroppingText.description: Default true. When true, compilers should leave padding around text-heavy regions and avoid aggressive zoom that crops readable content.

avoidFastMotion.description: When true, compilers should prefer slower transitions and longer holds.

allowWhipPan.description: Default true. When true, some recipes may use whip-pan transitions between distant regions.

allowBlur.description: When false, rendering should avoid velocity blur effects even when motion is fast.

maxZoom.description: Maximum allowed zoom multiplier for compiler-generated camera shots.

minHoldSeconds.description: Optional lower bound for hold durations.
